scope: Fresh source build and no-AP LiDAR/IMU with historical algorithm-level 2D proxies only; not new joint-flow flight, FAST-LIO/LIVO runtime, camera/range or hardware validation.

prebuild_attempt.reason: colcon list inherited cwd=/ and attempted log creation there; permission rejected. Original failed log retained. New deployment helper explicitly sets cwd and log-base; no algorithm change.

tests.scope: Two Python package test suites with freshly built interfaces/install. Existing isolated ROS execution-wrapper tests have commands disabled; no AP process is started.

limitations: Observed LiDAR ~6.3Hz is not a 10Hz throughput guarantee or proof of zero transport/source drops.
Default xq_sil starts old 2D algorithm proxies, not the freshly built FAST-LIO/EGO executable runtimes or the new LIVO joint estimator.
No camera/range/AP physical model is loaded in this no-AP self-contained world.
Health messages represent multiple modules and can share stamps; strict stamp monotonicity is checked only on physical LiDAR/IMU sensor streams.
Source and third-party models/worlds are unchanged; system package database/dependencies were not modified.
